digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter — capability detection, field validation, inbound probe port
propositions: capability-map post-run validation refuses to vouch for Epic-field reports it cannot verify, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json rather than applying pre-run await gates

four capability call sites are guarded at runtime using isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback, reporting capability-absent vs capability-raised distinctly on bridge_alerts channel instead of silently failing
dormant inbound absence-probe port and its three probe_remote implementations, shared classifier, and neutral vocabulary module are deleted from the codebase
Python 3.12+ runtime_checkable isinstance behavior diverges from ADR-0083 due to getattr_static not resolving __getattr__-proxying transports, requiring documented guard shape fallback
live DC harness failures predate this epic's three commits and trace to commit c87afedba8, not a regression from these hardening changes
